about.title: About Us
about.story: eSONO s.r.o. was established in July 2025 as the successor to the ultrasound division of EXRAY s.r.o. We took over the complete equipment portfolio, customer relationships and service commitments to continue providing top-tier ultrasound diagnostic services.
about.mission: Our mission is to provide comprehensive ultrasound diagnostic services — from equipment sales and distribution to expert servicing and repairs. We primarily partner with GE Healthcare, whose devices are among the world's finest.
about.expertise: Our team brings years of experience in ultrasound technology. We hold a trade license for installation, repairs, inspections and testing of electrical equipment, enabling us to provide complete technical support.
about.clients: We serve dozens of active clients — hospitals, clinics and private medical practices throughout the Czech Republic. We prioritise an individual approach and long-term partnerships with every customer.
why.title: Why Choose eSONO?
why.subtitle: We combine expertise, reliability and a personal approach — everything you expect from a partner in ultrasound diagnostics.
why.certified.title: Certified Service
why.certified.desc: We hold a trade license for installation, repairs, inspections and testing of electrical equipment. Your device is in expert hands.
why.partner.title: Personal Approach
why.partner.desc: Every client has a dedicated contact technician. We're not an anonymous helpline — we're partners you can rely on.
why.lifecycle.title: Full Lifecycle Support
why.lifecycle.desc: From selecting the right device through installation and regular servicing to upgrades. We take care of everything in one place.
services.title: Our Services
services.sales.title: Ultrasound Equipment Sales
services.sales.desc: We supply ultrasound devices from the leading brand GE Healthcare — Vivid series (cardiology), LOGIQ (general imaging), Voluson (obstetrics/gynaecology) and Versana. We offer both new and refurbished systems, plus a wide range of probes and accessories.
services.distribution.title: Distribution & Delivery
services.distribution.desc: We handle complete deliveries of ultrasound equipment and probes to healthcare facilities across the Czech Republic. Our services include full logistics and professional installation.
services.service.title: Service & Repairs
services.service.desc: We provide regular maintenance, preventive servicing, diagnostics and repairs of ultrasound equipment. We hold a trade license for installation, repairs, inspections and testing of electrical equipment.
services.rental.title: Equipment Rental
services.rental.desc: We offer long-term rental of ultrasound equipment and probes on flexible terms. An ideal solution for healthcare facilities that prefer leasing over purchasing.
